layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous (use p-6 to p-12 for containers, gap-6 to gap-8 for grids)
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense but readable). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for the dashboard module cards.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Sharp to slight curves (rounded-none or rounded-sm/md). Maximum 6px for a precise, architectural luxury feel.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10
surfaces.cards: Solid background (#0A0A0A) with 1px border-white/5. On hover: border-[#D4AF37]/50 and subtle shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.15)].

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black hover:bg-[#F3E5AB] font-bold tracking-wide transition-all duration-300

components_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn inputs. Background bg-black/40, border border-white/10, focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37].
components_instructions.navigation: Sticky top header with glassmorphism. Left: Logo. Center/Right: Key nav links. Far Right: DE/EN toggle and profile CTA.
components_instructions.language_toggle: Simple, elegant text toggle (DE | EN) with active state in gold (#D4AF37).
components_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='generate-copy-btn').

modules.name: Dashboard
modules.layout: Grid of feature cards with deep black backgrounds, metallic gold hover borders, and glowing phosphor icons.

modules.name: Modul 1: Brand Designer
modules.features: Form to store logo, colors, fonts, buttons, image style.

modules.name: Modul 2: Social Media Maschine
modules.features: Single prompt input generating consistent posts for IG, FB, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads with emojis, hashtags, CTAs, image suggestions.

modules.name: Modul 4: KI Bildgenerator
modules.features: Prompt input with luxury style templates (luxuriös, modern, minimalistisch, Business, Premium, Gold, Schwarz, Neon, Corporate, Cartoon, Comic, Anime, Futuristisch). Grid output.

modules.name: Modul 7: KI Copywriter
modules.features: Format selection (sales text, product description, Amazon, Etsy, Shopify, newsletter, blog, TikTok hook, YouTube description). Rich text output card with copy/export.

modules.name: Modul 10: Prompt Bibliothek
modules.features: Categorized list/grid (Marketing, Sales, Websites, AI Images, Video, SEO, Branding, Email, Chatbots, Funnels) with search functionality.

backgrounds.description: Dubai skyline night - use for auth or hero background with heavy black gradient overlay (bg-black/80).
Abstract gold light trails - use sparingly as atmospheric texture behind key sections.
Dark textured luxury wall - use as base page background if solid color is too flat.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS purely. When using Shadcn, override styles to match the 'Luxury Dark Mode' theme.
Never use pure white backgrounds. Everything must be dark theme native.
Implement the 'Crystal Glass' strategy for the header: sticky nav with heavy blur and sharp 1px border.
Use the exact media URLs provided under the 'media' key. Do not invent or use placeholders.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
Include a prominent DE/EN toggle in the navigation.
For the output cards in Social Media Maschine and KI Copywriter, include clear 'Copy' and 'Export' buttons.
Keep typography high-contrast. Use 'Playfair Display' for headings to exude luxury, and 'Manrope' for the UI body text to ensure modern SaaS readability.
